note: This diagnostic explains the 0% detection rate; it does not relax the evaluation threshold.

cause.explanation: Every simulated point has only two concurrent tables but on-duty=3 and the label adds +1 for short. The model predicts no gap (required 2 <= on-duty 3), so no actual-shortage point can be detected. This is a scenario/label inconsistency and model underprediction, not a threshold that should be lowered.
